system.description:
The world of sight is lost to you. You automatically lose all ties where sight is a factor, such as tests of manual dexterity, and you fail outright any challenge that requires sight. You cannot be affected by Dominate, since you cannot meet an opponent's gaze, but that is about the limit of the benefit.

You can still use the Auspex power Aura Perception, sensing auras through smell, sound and other senses. Wear a tag or glasses to indicate the Flaw.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
